change_reason: Align the candidate scorer with the current Critic lifecycle contract: llm_review.status is a final status (passed/failed/incomplete), not the old intermediate 'invoked' value. Require each optional review to bind to its actual Critic logical call and SDK attempt.
unchanged: Candidate IDs, questions, scope, periods, independent truth, registered methods, tolerances, units, and denominators.
Full requires groundedness, completeness, and consistency to complete with passed verdicts and an approved final Critic for task acceptance.
Off requires evaluation_ablation for the three reviews and zero optional Critic calls; deterministic review remains required.
Evidence, numeric, output, causal-boundary, execution, and completed-presentation requirements remain unchanged from v4.
Historical v1-v4 functions, scores, and run records remain preserved and are not rewritten.

status_contract.full_review_execution_complete: Each of the three review entries has completion_status=completed, a recognized verdict, and call_ids/sdk_attempt_ids that map to successful Critic extract calls and their actual attempts.
status_contract.full_task_acceptance: Review execution is complete, every verdict is passed, and the final Critic status is approved, in addition to all v4 task checks.
status_contract.off_review_execution_complete: llm_review.mode=critic_llm_review_off, status=evaluation_ablation, all three verdicts=evaluation_ablation, and no Critic extract calls.
status_contract.unknown_or_missing_bindings: Fail closed; never inferred from an aggregate status alone.

not_claimed: No tolerance, candidate truth, task denominator, or acceptance threshold is relaxed.
This scorer revision is not evidence of model quality improvement and does not authorize or execute Provider calls.
